manual.title: Sign in to Lidl Plus
manual.description:
1. On a computer, open this link: [accounts.lidl.com]({auth_url})
2. Enter your e-mail or phone number. **Before the last step** (password or verification code), press F12 and open the **Console** tab.
3. Finish signing in. The page will not redirect anywhere — that is expected.
4. Copy the console line `Failed to launch 'com.lidlplus.app://callback?code=…'` (or just the `com.lidlplus.app://…` address) and paste it below. If the console is empty, use the **Network** tab: the last request has a `Location: com.lidlplus.app://…` header.

The code is valid only briefly, so paste it right away. If it is rejected, sign in again with the same link.

companion.title: Browser Companion
companion.description:
Open Browser Companion in a new window:

[{companion_url}]({companion_href})

Complete captcha, password and MFA there. This screen waits for the com.lidlplus.app:// redirect.
